<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W=240,H=294,period=5540,TAU=2*Math.PI;
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W,H,false);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xfffefe);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,147,-147,.1,1600);
ref.position.set(22,147,600);
ref.lookAt(22,147,0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();

const grain=`
vec3 stipple(vec2 pixel,float amount){
  vec2 p=floor(pixel);
  float a=mod(p.x+2.*p.y,4.);
  float b=mod(2.*p.x+p.y+floor(p.y/4.),5.);
  float fleck=fract(52.9829189*fract(dot(p,vec2(.06711056,.00583715))))-.5;
  return amount*(vec3(.058,.008,-.082)*(a-1.5)/1.5+(b-2.)*.012+fleck*.032);
}`;
const backdrop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthTest:false,depthWrite:false,
  vertexShader:`void main(){gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,.99999,1.);}`,
  fragmentShader:`
    precision highp float;
    ${grain}
    void main(){
      vec2 p=vec2(gl_FragCoord.x,294.-gl_FragCoord.y);
      float y=p.y;
      vec3 c=mix(vec3(.83,.835,.81),vec3(.852,.887,.966),smoothstep(-2.,14.,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(.906,.92,.989),smoothstep(15.,50.,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(.956,.935,.992),smoothstep(51.,63.,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(1.,.999,.993),smoothstep(62.,78.,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(.944,.951,.997),smoothstep(218.,242.,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(.861,.859,.813),smoothstep(243.,264.,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(.715,.72,.732),smoothstep(263.,297.,y));
      vec2 q=(p-vec2(82.,305.))/vec2(98.,30.);
      c-=.055*exp(-dot(q,q));
      float paper=.10+.90*(1.-smoothstep(50.,83.,y)+smoothstep(218.,272.,y));
      c+=stipple(gl_FragCoord.xy,paper*(.87+.13*sin(p.x*.034+y*.019)));
      gl_FragColor=vec4(clamp(c,0.,1.),1.);
    }`
}));
backdrop.name='Pale studio background';
backdrop.frustumCulled=false;
backdrop.renderOrder=-1000;
scene.add(backdrop);

const skin=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader:`
    varying vec3 pigment;
    varying vec3 worldNormal;
    varying vec3 viewDirection;
    void main(){
      vec4 mv=modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.);
      worldNormal=(normalMatrix*normal)*mat3(viewMatrix);
      viewDirection=(isOrthographic?vec3(0.,0.,1.):normalize(-mv.xyz))*mat3(viewMatrix);
      pigment=color;
      gl_Position=projectionMatrix*mv;
    }`,
  fragmentShader:`
    precision highp float;
    varying vec3 pigment;
    varying vec3 worldNormal;
    varying vec3 viewDirection;
    ${grain}
    void main(){
      vec3 n=normalize(worldNormal),v=normalize(viewDirection);
      vec3 key=normalize(vec3(-.43,.83,.59)),fill=normalize(vec3(.83,.38,.52));
      float k=max(dot(key,n),0.),f=max(dot(fill,n),0.);
      float light=.777+.106*n.y+.205*k+.127*f+.023*n.z;
      vec3 c=pigment*vec3(light+.012,light,light-.015);
      float sheen=pow(max(dot(n,normalize(key+v)),0.),13.);
      float rim=pow(1.-clamp(dot(n,v),0.,1.),2.5)*max(dot(n,normalize(vec3(.88,.48,-.19))),0.);
      c+=vec3(.055,.052,.035)*sheen*(.35+.65*pigment.r);
      c=mix(c,vec3(1.,.935,.718),rim*.33);
      c+=stipple(gl_FragCoord.xy,.63);
      gl_FragColor=vec4(clamp(c,0.,1.),1.);
    }`
});
skin.name='Soft golden skin';
const clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
const mix=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const blend=(a,b,t)=>a.map((v,i)=>mix(v,b[i],t));
const sq=x=>x*x;
function smooth(a,b,x){const t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a));return t*t*(3-2*t)}
function spot(x,y,cx,cy,rx,ry){return Math.exp(-sq((x-cx)/rx)-sq((y-cy)/ry))}
function section(table,y){
  let i=0;
  while(i<table.length-2 && y>table[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=table[i],b=table[i+1],p=table[Math.max(0,i-1)],q=table[Math.min(table.length-1,i+2)];
  const d=b[0]-a[0],t=clamp((y-a[0])/d),t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
  return a.slice(1).map((v,k)=>{
    const j=k+1;
    return (2*t3-3*t2+1)*v+(t3-2*t2+t)*(b[j]-p[j])*d/(b[0]-p[0])
      +(-2*t3+3*t2)*b[j]+(t3-t2)*(q[j]-a[j])*d/(q[0]-a[0]);
  });
}
function palette(table,y){
  let i=0;
  while(i<table.length-2 && y>table[i+1][0])i++;
  return blend(table[i].slice(1),table[i+1].slice(1),smooth(table[i][0],table[i+1][0],y));
}
function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;parent.add(g);return g;
}
const character=group(scene,'Golden pear-shaped creature');
const torso=group(character,'Torso and belly'),head=group(torso,'Head');
const face=group(head,'Face'),eyes=group(face,'Eyes and lids'),mouth=group(face,'Mouth');
const hips=group(character,'Hips');
const trunk=[
 [17.8,101,.045,.4,.05],[18.7,101,6.7,.5,7],[21.5,101,12.5,.8,12],
 [26,100.9,17,1.3,16],[32,100.5,20,2.1,18.3],[39.5,99.5,22.25,2.4,19.45],

 [81,94.8,38.1,-2,26.5],[96,95.9,41.3,0,30.7],[110,97,44.6,2.8,35.4],

const hidePalette=[

 [214,235,164,50],[224,230,158,51],[251,221,147,48],[284,213,139,48],[316,199,131,48]

function relief(x,y){
  if(y>67)return 0;
  return 2.4*spot(x,y,91.2,34.7,8,3.5)+2*spot(x,y,111.7,34.3,6.7,3.1)
    -1.25*spot(x,y,91.3,38.5,6.8,2.1)-1.05*spot(x,y,112.5,38,5.7,2)
    +2.7*spot(x,y,103.5,39.7,5.6,6.3)+4.4*spot(x,y,103.2,45.7,11.4,4.2)
    +1.65*spot(x,y,102,52.2,10.9,4)+1.2*spot(x,y,86.5,45,5.5,6.8);
}
function frontDepth(x,y){
  const [cx,rx,cz,rz]=section(trunk,y);
  const c=Math.sqrt(Math.max(.0001,1-sq((x-cx)/rx)));
  return cz+rz*c+relief(x,y)*smooth(0,.65,c);
}
function coreColor(x,y,z,a,open){
  const f=smooth(-.18,.87,Math.cos(a));
  let c=palette(hidePalette,y);
  if(y<65){
    const l=spot(x,y,mix(90,85.4,open),37.5,8.4,mix(3.4,6,open))
       +.86*spot(x,y,mix(113,114.8,open),37,7,mix(3.1,5.7,open));
    c=blend(c,blend([188,157,45],[164,174,55],open),clamp(l*.58*f));
    c=blend(c,[197,130,47],.44*f*spot(x,y,104,53,16,6.8));
  }
  if(y>76){
    c=blend(c,[255,221,185],.92*spot(x,y,110,133,62,33)*smooth(-.26,.66,Math.cos(a)));
    c=blend(c,[255,240,181],.55*f*spot(x,y,96,112,33,16));
    c=blend(c,[242,191,154],.40*f*spot(x,y,132,146,29,23));
    c=blend(c,[208,159,80],.24*f*spot(x,y,99,169,45,11));
    c=blend(c,[139,86,36],.86*smooth(195,228,y)*Math.exp(-sq((x-99)/6.4)));
    const flank=(1-f)*spot(x,y,147,142,29,16);
    c=blend(c,[251,167,47],.35*flank);
  }
  const w=1.4*Math.sin(x*.095+y*.033+z*.061)*Math.sin(y*.105-x*.019);
  return [c[0]+w,c[1]+.7*w,c[2]];
}

// The center line carries the head and belly together as the figure leans,
// steps forward, and turns. Each row is a horizontal anatomical section.
const levels=[17.8,38,61,82,112,166,198,224,265,313.3];
const ones=levels.map(()=>1);
const restCenters=levels.map(y=>section(trunk,Math.min(224,y))[0]);
const poses=[];
function pose(time,yaw,x,y,sx,sz,open,smile,stride){
  const table=levels.map((v,i)=>[v,x[i],y[i],sx[i],sz[i]]);
  poses.push({time,yaw,table,rootX:x[5],rootY:y[5],c:Math.cos(yaw),s:Math.sin(yaw),open,smile,stride});
}

pose(5470,-1.59,[107.6,101.3,112.4,121.6,128.4,131.7,132.3,131.1,128.3,127],

function bodyPoint(k,x,y,z,legSide=0){
  const p=poses[k];
  if(k===0)return [x-p.rootX,p.rootY-y,z];
  const base=section(trunk,Math.min(y,224));
  const [cx,yy,wx,wz]=section(p.table,y);
  const travel=legSide*p.stride*smooth(224,287,y);
  const dx=cx-p.rootX+travel,cz=base[2]*p.c*wz;
  return [p.c*dx-p.s*cz+(x-base[0])*wx,p.rootY-yy,
          p.s*dx+p.c*cz+(z-base[2])*wz];
}

// Surfaces share ring topology across poses, including the fork into the legs.
const animated=[];
function topology(rows,sides){
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry(),indices=[];
  for(let j=0;j<rows;j++)for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){
    const a=j*sides+i,b=j*sides+(i+1)%sides;
    indices.push(a,a+sides,b+sides,a,b+sides,b);
  }
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  return geo;
}
function attr(array){return new THREE.BufferAttribute(array,3)}
function baked(parent,name,rows,sides,fn){
  const geo=topology(rows,sides),frames=[];
  const size=(rows+1)*sides*3;
  for(let k=0;k<poses.length;k++){
    const pos=new Float32Array(size),col=new Float32Array(size);
    for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++)for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){
      const [v,c]=fn(k,j/rows,TAU*i/sides);
      const h=(j*sides+i)*3;
      pos.set(v,h);col[h]=c[0]/255;col[h+1]=c[1]/255;col[h+2]=c[2]/255;
    }
    geo.setAttribute('position',attr(pos));geo.deleteAttribute('normal');geo.computeVertexNormals();
    frames.push([pos,geo.attributes.normal.array,col]);
  }
  const names=['position','normal','color'];
  names.forEach((n,i)=>geo.setAttribute(n,attr(frames[0][i].slice()).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage)));
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,skin);mesh.name=name;mesh.frustumCulled=false;parent.add(mesh);
  animated.push((a,b,t)=>{
    names.forEach((n,j)=>{
      const target=geo.attributes[n],dst=target.array,f=frames[a][j],g=frames[b][j];
      if(t===0)dst.set(f);
      else for(let i=0;i<dst.length;i++)dst[i]=mix(f[i],g[i],t);
      target.needsUpdate=true;
    });
    geo.computeBoundingBox();geo.computeBoundingSphere();
  });
}
function bodySection(parent,name,y0,y1,rows){
  baked(parent,name,rows,80,(k,u,a)=>{
    const y=mix(y0,y1,u),[cx,rx,cz,rz]=section(trunk,y);
    const sn=Math.sin(a),cs=Math.cos(a),angle=Math.acos(clamp(cs,-1,1)),s=smooth(193,224,y);
    const x=cx+rx*mix(sn,Math.sign(sn)*(.5-.5*Math.cos(2*angle)),s);
    const z=cz+mix(rz*cs,22.6*Math.sin(2*angle),s)+relief(x,y)*smooth(0,.65,cs);
    return [bodyPoint(k,x,y,z),coreColor(x,y,z,a,poses[k].open)];
  });
}
bodySection(head,'Crown, cheeks and chin',17.8,61,56);
bodySection(torso,'Shoulders, breast and abdomen',61,224,82);
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const left=side<0,label=left?'Left':'Right',start=99+side*39.55/2;
  const leg=group(hips,label+' leg'),foot=group(leg,label+' foot');
  const prof=[
   [224,start,39.55/2,2.1,22.6],[233,left?79.7:118.9,18.9,1.8,22],
   [247,left?80.8:118,left?16.85:17,1.25,20.1],[264,left?82.6:116.9,left?14.4:15.15,.35,17.9],
   [280,left?84:115.9,left?12.8:13.6,-.1,16.1],[294,left?84.9:115.1,left?11.85:12.75,-.3,15.2],

  ];
  function legSection(parent,name,lo,hi,rows){

      const y=mix(lo,hi,u),[cx,rx,cz,rz]=section(prof,y);
      const x=cx+rx*Math.sin(a),z=cz+rz*Math.cos(a);
      const shade=.78*Math.pow(clamp(-side*Math.sin(a)),5)*Math.exp(-Math.max(0,y-224)/68);
      return [bodyPoint(k,x,y,z,side),blend(palette(hidePalette,y),[133,80,33],shade)];
    });
  }
  legSection(leg,label+' thigh and calf',224,298,36);
  legSection(foot,label+' rounded foot',298,313.3,17);
}

// Lenticular features follow the curvature of the head through the turn.
for(const left of [true,false]){
  const eye=group(eyes,left?'Left eye':'Right eye');
  function eyeDims(k){
    const o=poses[k].open;
    return [mix(left?90.75:113.15,left?85.35:114.8,o),
      mix(left?37.65:37.2,left?38.65:37.5,o),mix(left?6.05:4.9,4.25,o),mix(.44,4.85,o)];
  }
  baked(eye,'Eye opening',24,28,(k,u,a)=>{
    const o=poses[k].open,[cx,cy,rx,ry]=eyeDims(k);
    const dx=-Math.cos(Math.PI*u),taper=Math.max(.006,Math.sin(Math.PI*u));
    const dy=taper*Math.sin(a),x=cx+rx*dx,y=cy-ry*dy+.32*(1-o)*taper;
    const z=frontDepth(x,y)+.29+taper*mix(.50,2.85,o)*Math.cos(a);
    const r=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    let c=blend([17,25,15],[37,52,23],smooth(.45,.79,r));
    c=blend(c,[125,146,48],smooth(.72,1,r));
    c=blend(c,[100,115,63],.31*spot(dx,dy,-.27,.38,.17,.19));
    return [bodyPoint(k,x,y,z),blend(blend([138,124,49],[194,157,49],r),c,o)];
  });
  for(const upper of [false,true]){
    baked(eye,upper?'Upper lid':'Lower lid',22,12,(k,u,a)=>{
      const o=poses[k].open,[cx,cy,rx,ry]=eyeDims(k);
      const taper=.01+.99*Math.sin(Math.PI*u),x=cx-rx*Math.cos(Math.PI*u);
      const edge=upper?-1:1;
      const y=cy+edge*taper*(ry+(upper?.61:.43))-
        taper*mix(upper?1.14:.70,.55,o)*Math.sin(a);
      const z=frontDepth(x,y)+taper*(.14+.68*Math.cos(a));
      return [bodyPoint(k,x,y,z),upper?[232,182,47]:[219,171,54]];
    });
  }
}

  baked(mouth,['Lower lip','Upper lip','Mouth crease'][layer],32,16,(k,u,a)=>{
    const p=poses[k],o=p.open,sin=Math.sin(Math.PI*u),taper=.012+.988*Math.pow(Math.max(0,sin),.7);

      -[1.10,1.37,.62][layer]*taper*Math.sin(a);

    const c=layer===2?blend([191,145,45],[100,76,35],.88*Math.pow(sin,.63)):
      layer===0?[225,162,53]:blend([226,169,49],[240,186,55],.5+.4*Math.sin(a));
    return [bodyPoint(k,x,y,z),c];

}

const leftArm=[
 [[66.2,71,-4],[45.3,148,3.3],[38.9,179.5,9.1],[33,199,13.8],[30.7,214.5,17.5],[40.7,203.5,18.8],[1,0,.08],7.5,4.45,3.9,6.0,.12],
 [[46,87,12],[51.8,127.4,31],[79.6,88,48],[92.2,82,51],[104.1,74.1,47],[103.6,89.3,51],[.30,-.52,-.80],11.7,11.4,5.7,7.2,.18],

const v3=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
function localPoint(k,arr,direction=false){
  const p=poses[k],dx=arr[0]-(direction?0:p.rootX),z=arr[2];
  return v3(p.c*dx-p.s*z,(direction?0:p.rootY)-arr[1],p.s*dx+p.c*z);
}
function pointBetween(a,b,t){return a.clone().lerp(b,t)}
function knot(center,wide,deep,color){return {center,wide,deep,color}}
const gold=[247,187,43],sunny=[249,192,49],ochre=[228,177,64],
  wristGold=[165,131,55],wristBrown=[130,107,54],brown=[84,73,47],
  dark=[63,58,42],tips=[102,89,57];
function tube(parent,name,rows,sides){
  const g=topology(rows,sides),len=(rows+1)*sides*3;
  for(const n of ['position','normal','color'])
    g.setAttribute(n,attr(new Float32Array(len)).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(g,skin);mesh.name=name;mesh.frustumCulled=false;parent.add(mesh);
  const sines=[],cosines=[];
  for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){sines.push(Math.sin(TAU*i/sides));cosines.push(Math.cos(TAU*i/sides))}
  return (knots,widthAxis)=>{
    const positions=g.attributes.position.array,colors=g.attributes.color.array;
    const T=v3(),U=v3(),V=v3(),C=v3();
    for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++){
      const u=j/rows*(knots.length-1),i=Math.min(Math.floor(u),knots.length-2),t=u-i,t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
      const a=knots[i],b=knots[i+1],prev=knots[Math.max(0,i-1)],next=knots[Math.min(knots.length-1,i+2)];
      const m0=b.center.clone().sub(prev.center).multiplyScalar(i===0?.72:.43);
      const m1=next.center.clone().sub(a.center).multiplyScalar(i+2===knots.length?.72:.43);
      C.copy(a.center).multiplyScalar(2*t3-3*t2+1).addScaledVector(b.center,-2*t3+3*t2)
        .addScaledVector(m0,t3-2*t2+t).addScaledVector(m1,t3-t2);
      T.copy(a.center).multiplyScalar(6*t2-6*t).addScaledVector(b.center,6*t-6*t2)
        .addScaledVector(m0,3*t2-4*t+1).addScaledVector(m1,3*t2-2*t).normalize();
      if(j===0)U.copy(widthAxis);
      U.addScaledVector(T,-U.dot(T));
      if(U.lengthSq()<.00001){U.set(0,0,1);if(Math.abs(T.z)>.88)U.set(1,0,0);U.addScaledVector(T,-U.dot(T))}
      U.normalize();V.crossVectors(T,U).normalize();
      const e=t*t*(3-2*t);
      const rx=mix(a.wide,b.wide,t),rz=mix(a.deep,b.deep,t),col=blend(a.color,b.color,e);
      for(let l=0;l<sides;l++){
        const h=(j*sides+l)*3,s=rx*sines[l],c=rz*cosines[l];
        positions[h]=C.x+U.x*s+V.x*c;positions[h+1]=C.y+U.y*s+V.y*c;positions[h+2]=C.z+U.z*s+V.z*c;
        colors[h]=col[0]/255;colors[h+1]=col[1]/255;colors[h+2]=col[2]/255;
      }
    }
    g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;g.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;
    g.computeVertexNormals();g.computeBoundingBox();g.computeBoundingSphere();
  };
}
function makeArm(data,label){
  const arm=group(torso,label+' arm'),fore=group(arm,label+' forearm'),hand=group(fore,label+' hand');
  const upperTube=tube(arm,'Upper arm',35,32),lowerTube=tube(fore,'Forearm',30,32),palmTube=tube(hand,'Palm',24,32);
  const digits=['Little finger','Ring finger','Middle finger','Index finger','Thumb'].map(n=>tube(group(hand,n),n+' skin',19,16));
  const frames=data.map((row,k)=>({
    vectors:row.slice(0,7).map((a,i)=>localPoint(k,a,i===6)),values:row.slice(7)
  }));
  animated.push((a,b,t)=>{
    const f=frames[a],g=frames[b],vectors=f.vectors.map((p,i)=>pointBetween(p,g.vectors[i],t));
    const [S,E,W,K,F,thumb,across]=vectors;
    const [upperR,elbowR,wristR,palmR,spread]=blend(f.values,g.values,t);
    const gesture=mix(a===0?0:1,b===0?0:1,t);
    const axis=across.normalize();
    const cap=S.clone();cap.x*=.67;cap.z*=.73;cap.y+=5;
    const top=pointBetween(S,E,.25),mid=pointBetween(S,E,.59);
    const elbowT=W.clone().sub(S).normalize();
    const jointStart=E.clone().addScaledVector(elbowT,-Math.min(3,elbowR*.35));
    const jointEnd=E.clone().addScaledVector(elbowT,Math.min(3,elbowR*.35));
    upperTube([
      knot(cap,.10,.10,gold),knot(S,upperR*.82,upperR*.95,gold),
      knot(top,upperR*1.02,upperR*1.16,sunny),knot(mid,mix(upperR,elbowR,.40),mix(upperR,elbowR,.34)*1.12,blend(sunny,ochre,.31)),
      knot(jointStart,elbowR,elbowR*1.10,ochre),knot(jointEnd,elbowR*.96,elbowR*1.06,ochre)
    ],axis);
    const wristT=K.clone().sub(E).normalize();
    lowerTube([
      knot(jointStart,elbowR,elbowR*1.10,ochre),knot(jointEnd,elbowR*.99,elbowR*1.085,ochre),
      knot(pointBetween(E,W,.32),mix(elbowR,wristR,.12),mix(elbowR,wristR,.09)*1.1,blend(ochre,sunny,gesture*.60)),
      knot(pointBetween(E,W,.72),mix(elbowR,wristR,.65),mix(elbowR,wristR,.63)*1.12,blend(wristGold,ochre,.24+gesture*.69)),
      knot(W,wristR,wristR*1.09,blend(wristBrown,wristGold,gesture*.70)),
      knot(W.clone().addScaledVector(wristT,2.0),wristR*.94,wristR*1.04,blend(wristBrown,wristGold,gesture*.50))
    ],axis);
    const along=K.clone().sub(W).normalize();
    const width=axis.clone().addScaledVector(along,-axis.dot(along)).normalize();
    const normal=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(along,width).normalize();
    const palmMid=pointBetween(W,K,.53);
    palmTube([
      knot(W.clone().addScaledVector(along,-1.5),wristR*.93,wristR,blend(wristBrown,wristGold,gesture*.76)),
      knot(pointBetween(W,K,.19),wristR*1.06,wristR*1.12,blend(wristBrown,brown,.28)),
      knot(palmMid,palmR*.86,palmR*.79,brown),knot(pointBetween(W,K,.86),palmR,palmR*.72,dark),
      knot(K,palmR*.84,palmR*.54,dark),knot(K.clone().addScaledVector(along,2),palmR*.27,palmR*.25,dark)
    ],width);
    const reach=F.clone().sub(K);
    const sizes=[.78,.98,1,.83];
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const h=(i-1.5)/1.5;
      const base=pointBetween(W,K,.82+.07*(1-Math.abs(h))).addScaledVector(width,h*palmR*.75);
      const end=K.clone().addScaledVector(reach,sizes[i]).addScaledVector(width,h*palmR*(.83+.89*spread));
      const p1=pointBetween(base,end,.38).addScaledVector(normal,.78);
      const p2=pointBetween(base,end,.76).addScaledVector(normal,.42);
      const r=palmR*[.267,.302,.310,.285][i];
      digits[i]([knot(base,r*.92,r,dark),knot(p1,r,r*1.02,dark),
        knot(p2,r*.78,r*.90,[66,61,43]),knot(pointBetween(p2,end,.75),r*.55,r*.62,[78,70,48]),
        knot(end,.055,.07,tips)],width);
    }
    const thumbStart=pointBetween(W,K,.48).addScaledVector(width,palmR*.56);
    const thumbMid=pointBetween(thumbStart,thumb,.46).addScaledVector(width,palmR*.18);
    const r=palmR*.345;
    digits[4]([knot(thumbStart,r*.98,r*1.08,brown),knot(thumbMid,r,r*1.05,dark),
      knot(pointBetween(thumbMid,thumb,.71),r*.72,r*.83,dark),knot(thumb,.06,.07,tips)],width);
  });
}

function render(t){
  const ms=((t%period)+period)%period;
  let a=0;
  while(a<poses.length-1 && ms>=poses[a+1].time)a++;
  const b=(a+1)%poses.length;
  const span=(b===0?period:poses[b].time)-poses[a].time;
  const u=clamp((ms-poses[a].time)/span),w=u*u*(3-2*u);
  const f=poses[a],g=poses[b];
  character.position.set(mix(f.rootX,g.rootX,w)-98,294-mix(f.rootY,g.rootY,w),0);
  character.rotation.y=mix(f.yaw,g.yaw,w);
  for(const update of animated)update(a,b,w);
  scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
